description:
Branches delete themselves after a while, so a forgotten one does not keep costing money. This extends that deadline, or removes it entirely.

Removing it is a real decision, not a convenience: a kept branch holds its source's old blocks, which count against the source's storage. When that fills, growing it (by hand or automatically) is what costs, which is not obvious from looking at the branch.

expires_in_days.description: Days from now, or null to keep the branch indefinitely

id.description: Instance id, as returned by list_instances

name: set_branch_expiry
title: Change when a branch expires
